description: Synthetic sesslint._canonical_codec parity vectors (JSON shapes only, no session payloads).
known_parity_gaps: normalize_canonical_key_order: Rust reify uses BTreeMap sorted keys; Python dict normalization keeps insertion order until json.dumps sort_keys. Parity compares canonical_json_bytes only, not normalize_canonical map order.
session_event_content_identity: SessionEvent is not ported; content_identity_bytes/hash return Unsupported until the type exists.
active_codec_env: parity does not set SESSLINT_DISABLE_ACCEL or call set_active_codec; unit tests cover those paths.
